_comment: Two snapshots of the same issue under the proposed v2 schema. Switch between them in issue.preview.html to see how the contract evolves between claim and result.

incoming.title: Fix: kanban drag and drop not persisting status change
incoming.context: Dragging a card from To Do to In Progress visually updates the column but the issue's status reverts on page reload. The drop handler is updating in-memory state without calling updateIssue(), so localStorage is never written. This was caught when QA reloaded after a sprint planning session and the board reset.

acceptance_criteria.text: Dropping a card calls updateIssue() so the change is persisted to localStorage.
Reloading the page preserves the new column position.
An audit_log entry is written with the old → new status transition.
Regression test asserts that updateIssue() is called exactly once per drop.

incoming.escalate_when: If the drop handler has no obvious reference to updateIssue() or if multiple handlers race, stop and request a pairing session.

result.notes: Root cause: the drop handler was mutating dragging.dataset.status without invoking updateIssue(). Wired the call into the drop event and added a 4th-line audit entry stamping the transition. Regression test uses a spy on updateIssue() and asserts call count === 1 per drop, regardless of drag distance. Verified manually across reload, cross-tab, and the agent simulator's auto-loop.
